t: These Easydrive M3.5 x 75mm electrical screws are essential for secure indoor fastening applications. Manufactured from robust carbon steel with a matt black finish, they offer excellent corrosion resistance and a discreet appearance. The fully threaded machine thread ensures a strong, reliable fixing, making them ideal for electricians and trade professionals working on electrical installations or securing components within electrical boxes. Featuring a slotted raised head, these screws provide a neat surface finish and facilitate straightforward installation, ensuring a professional result every time.
